title: Quantum DS-MITM · Q2

target.description: Eight full AES rounds with the Figure4 boundary, key-schedule consistency equations and initial/final key additions; source claims full secret-key recovery.

setting.key_relation: One fixed standard AES master key and its key schedule.
setting.plaintext_model: 2^113 classical encryption queries for pair preparation, with coherent secret-cipher queries in nested filters.
assumptions: No qRAM: stored classical records are scanned sequentially.
2^136.62 is the quantum search S-box cost; pair-generation classical work is separately included in the source procedure.

quantum_model.gate_set: Source-native reversible S-box or abstract quantum algorithm operations; no physical gate estimate.
quantum_model.routing: Physical routing is not part of this algorithmic estimate.
quantum_model.error_correction: Physical error correction is not part of this algorithmic estimate.
quantum_model.oracle_parallelism: The source total-work model is retained without additional parallel-oracle speedups.
quantum_model.solution_assumption: A good middle-differential pair and solution-count precision hypotheses are used. The source accounts for ignored four-solution S-box branches and inner-search precision.

time.note: Section6.4 includes 2^0.45 S-box-branch compensation and explicit nested-search precision overhead.

data.note: Classical pair preparation uses 2^113 queries; a separate total coherent-query count is not supplied.

memory.reported: 2^{48} classical pair records; polynomial quantum workspace
memory.note: No qRAM table is required; source does not give a complete concrete quantum workspace count.

preprocessing.note: Pair preparation, not a reusable secret-key-independent setup.

t_gates.note: Algorithmic cryptanalysis estimate; this implementation metric is not supplied.

clifford_gates.note: Algorithmic cryptanalysis estimate; this implementation metric is not supplied.

t_depth.note: Algorithmic cryptanalysis estimate; this implementation metric is not supplied.

circuit_depth.note: Algorithmic cryptanalysis estimate; this implementation metric is not supplied.

logical_qubits.note: Algorithmic cryptanalysis estimate; this implementation metric is not supplied.

success.description: Local S-box-branch retention and precision errors are quantified; no combined original-key identification probability is stated at the full resource budget.

review.scope: PDF pp.19,23,27–28: good-pair, false-positive, branch loss and precision arguments.

evidence.locator: PDF pp.18–28 Section6/Figure4/Algorithm1, especially pp.23,26–28 costs and Q1 conversion.
evidence.interpretation: Defining primary-text costs, output event and conditions checked together.

limitations: The complete named output probability is not quantified by the source.
